blocks.h1: TGP cut operational time by 70% with Relvo.
blocks.lead: While its operation grew 30% in 3 months, TGP went from 6 to 3 days to complete its invoicing cycle.
blocks.intro: TGP is the largest prospecting agency in LatAm. It charges each customer a fixed fee plus a variable amount based on the month's results, and many of its customers require purchase orders before they will accept an invoice from the agency.

reply.author: Relvo
reply.text: Invoices calculated and sent for approval.

blocks.h2: What month-end closing used to look like.
before: At month-end, managers validated results with each customer.
A form and Zapier sent Slack notifications so someone could prepare each invoice by hand.
Customers requiring POs were tracked manually, and closing stretched to the 10th.
after: TGP sends monthly results through Slack, and Relvo calculates fixed and variable charges.
Invoices go out for the exact amount, without manual preparation.
Purchase orders are linked to each invoice, and the invoicing cycle dropped from 6 to 3 days.

blocks.note: Customer approvals and purchase orders included.

blocks.h2Soft: The same engine, from end to end.
